name: Torana Enterprise AI Gateway Feature Roadmap & Gap Analysis
description: Comprehensive catalog of essential enterprise-grade features, capabilities, and gap analysis required for production deployment in Fortune 500 and enterprise environments.

categories.name: AI Safety, Guardrails & Security
categories.description: Zero-trust protection, data loss prevention, and prompt attack defenses.

features.title: Real-time PII & Sensitive Data Masking / Tokenization
features.description: Automatic redaction, pseudonymization, or hashing of Personally Identifiable Information (SSN, credit cards, emails, phone numbers) and Protected Health Information (PHI) before forwarding payloads to external LLM providers.
features.enterprise_value: Ensures strict compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and CCPA; eliminates the risk of sensitive customer data leaking into public LLM training datasets.

features.title: Prompt Injection & Jailbreak Defense Interceptor
features.description: Inbound payload inspection that evaluates prompt injection, system prompt leakage attacks, and adversarial jailbreak attempts using model guardrails (e.g. Llama Guard, NeMo, or Lakera integration) before reaching backends.
features.enterprise_value: Protects enterprise systems and agents from malicious prompt manipulation, data exfiltration, and unauthorized privilege escalation.

features.title: Outbound Secret & Credential Leakage Scanner
features.description: Scans prompts and responses for accidental inclusion of AWS access keys, private RSA keys, database connection strings, and internal JWT tokens.
features.enterprise_value: Prevents catastrophic developer error where private enterprise keys are pasted into prompt workflows.

features.title: Content Moderation & Harmful Output Filtering
features.description: Bi-directional content safety checks for toxicity, hate speech, sexual content, and self-harm, with configurable block/flag actions per route.
features.enterprise_value: Protects brand reputation and satisfies corporate compliance policies.

categories.name: FinOps, Cost Intelligence & Token Quotas
categories.description: Granular budget controls, intelligent routing, and caching to reduce AI spend.

features.title: Multi-Tenant Token Quotas & Hard/Soft Budget Limits
features.description: Enforce Token-Per-Minute (TPM), Token-Per-Day (TPD), and dollar-denominated spend budgets per department, project, API key, or user. Includes webhook alerts at 80% soft limit and automatic request blocking at 100% hard limit.
features.enterprise_value: Prevents runaway LLM bills caused by infinite agent loops or rogue internal applications.

features.title: Semantic Response Caching (Vector Similarity)
features.description: Response caching based on vector embedding cosine similarity (e.g. Redis Vector Store or pgvector). If a semantically identical query was answered previously, returns cached response in <5ms without calling the LLM.
features.enterprise_value: Reduces external API token costs by 20%–40% and cuts p50 response latency from 3,000ms to 5ms.

features.title: Smart Cost-Optimized Dynamic Model Router
features.description: Analyzes prompt complexity and token length to route simple queries to low-cost models (e.g., GPT-4o-mini, Claude Haiku) and reserves frontier models (GPT-4o, Claude Opus) for complex multi-step reasoning.
features.enterprise_value: Dramatically lowers average cost-per-query across the enterprise without degrading response quality.

features.title: Token Usage & Cost Attribution Tagging
features.description: Emits structured FinOps billing records tagging exact prompt tokens, completion tokens, cached tokens, and estimated dollar costs per cost center and team.
features.enterprise_value: Enables internal chargebacks and financial accountability across departments.

categories.name: Agentic Architecture & MCP Tool Governance
categories.description: Capabilities for Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent coordination.

features.title: Fine-Grained Tool RBAC & Execution Policies
features.description: Role-Based Access Control and OPA policies specifically for individual MCP tools (e.g. allowing User A to run 'read_customer_doc' but restricting 'delete_record' or 'execute_sql').
features.enterprise_value: Prevents autonomous agents from executing destructive or unauthorized tool actions against internal backends.

features.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Tool Approval Flow
features.description: Suspends high-impact agent tool executions (e.g., financial transactions, database writes) into a pending state, dispatching an approval request via Slack/Email/Webhook until an authorized human approves.
features.enterprise_value: Critical requirement for regulated industries (finance, healthcare) before deploying autonomous agents in production.

features.title: Distributed Agent Session & Memory Management
features.description: Stateful agent conversation memory and context window management backed by distributed stores (Redis/DynamoDB), with automatic context summarization when token limits are approached.
features.enterprise_value: Enables persistent multi-turn agent conversations across stateless gateway clusters.

features.title: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Secure Communication Mesh
features.description: Enables agents to discover, authenticate, and call other agents through Torana routes with propagated identity, tenant scoping, and mutual TLS.
features.enterprise_value: Enables enterprise-wide autonomous multi-agent swarms with zero-trust perimeter control.

categories.name: Traffic Management, High-Scale Routing & Resilience
categories.description: Enterprise-scale routing algorithms, load balancing, and automated fallbacks.

features.title: Radix Tree (Trie) High-Scale Route Matching Engine
features.description: Upgrades the route registry from linear iteration to a Radix Tree (Path Trie) supporting O(K) lookup times across 10,000+ dynamic routes.
features.enterprise_value: Guarantees sub-millisecond route matching performance in massive enterprise multi-tenant deployments.

features.title: Canary & Weighted Multi-Model Traffic Splitting
features.description: Traffic splitting by percentage across models (e.g. 90% GPT-4o, 10% Claude 3.5 Sonnet) or A/B testing of prompt variations and pipeline steps.
features.enterprise_value: Allows safe rollouts of new model versions and empirical prompt engineering benchmarks.

features.title: Cascading Model Fallback & Provider Outage Failover
features.description: Automated failover chain (e.g. OpenAI -> Azure OpenAI -> Anthropic -> Self-hosted Ollama/vLLM) with circuit breaking on provider HTTP 429 (Rate Limit) and HTTP 503 (Outage) errors.
features.enterprise_value: Prevents external AI provider outages from causing enterprise downtime; guarantees 99.99% application availability.

categories.name: Observability, Telemetry & LLM Evals
categories.description: Comprehensive visibility into token latency, quality evaluations, and compliance audit streams.

features.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions Compliance
features.description: Full alignment with OpenTelemetry standard attributes (gen_ai.system, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens, gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens) exported to Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, or Prometheus.
features.enterprise_value: Integrates out-of-the-box with existing enterprise APM monitoring dashboards.

features.title: Real-time SIEM Audit Log Exporters (Splunk, Elastic, Kafka)
features.description: Stream SHA-256 hashed audit events directly into enterprise SIEM pipelines (Splunk, Elasticsearch, AWS CloudWatch, Apache Kafka) for non-repudiation.
features.enterprise_value: Mandatory for passing SOC-2, ISO-27001, and financial regulatory audits.

features.title: LLM Response Quality Evaluation & Feedback Capture
features.description: Asynchronous evaluation of LLM answers against ground truth or hallucination heuristics; capture end-user feedback (thumbs up/down) linked to trace IDs for model fine-tuning.
features.enterprise_value: Helps AI engineering teams monitor model drift, quality degradation, and optimize prompts over time.

categories.name: Admin Management, GitOps & Platform DevEx
categories.description: Enterprise control plane, Kubernetes integration, and developer tooling.

features.title: Enterprise Admin Web UI & Management Dashboard
features.description: Rich visual management console for live traffic visualization, route configuration, token spend analytics by tenant, active API keys, and audit log inspection.
features.enterprise_value: Gives non-technical platform administrators and FinOps managers full operational control without editing raw YAML.

features.title: Kubernetes Operator & Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)
features.description: Declarative Kubernetes CRDs (ToranaRoute, ToranaPipeline, ToranaPolicy) allowing platform teams to manage gateway routes natively via GitOps and ArgoCD.
features.enterprise_value: Enables seamless cloud-native GitOps deployment in Kubernetes clusters.

features.title: Interactive Route & Pipeline Testing Playground / Debugger
features.description: Browser-based sandbox to test SpEL expressions, preview RAG chunk formatting, test OPA rego policies, and debug pipeline step transitions with mock inputs.
features.enterprise_value: Accelerates developer onboarding and eliminates misconfiguration errors before deploying to production.
